subject: planner: column pruning must reserve at least one column (#54778)
summary: Reviewed planner-only changes: column pruning no longer produces empty projections from MPP DataSource pruning when parent needs no columns, and Projection.PruneColumns keeps a single dummy column when pruning would otherwise collapse to a schema-less TableDual; removed prior const-one workaround and added an intest-only invariant check. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in this commit vs first parent, and no later upstream fixes indicate a correctness regression in these touched areas.
